import sys
import re

def longest_words(line):
    if not line:
        return 0
    words = line.split('_')
    return max((len(w) for w in words), default=0)

def trim_parentheses(s):
    return s[1:-1]  # remove first and last characters

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])  # not used
    input_str = data[1] if len(data) > 1 else ''
    pattern = r"\([\w_]*\)"
    outside_parts = re.split(pattern, input_str)
    longest = max((longest_words(part) for part in outside_parts), default=0)
    matches = re.finditer(pattern, input_str)
    number_inside = 0
    for m in matches:
        inside = trim_parentheses(m.group())
        words_inside = inside.split('_')
        number_inside += sum(1 for w in words_inside if w)
    print(f"{longest} {number_inside}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
